# Towards Victory — Governor's House training action for Grand General (大将军)
# Appoint/Remove/Change actions are auto-generated in tv_io_leader_actions.txt
# via data/io_leaders.yaml entry id: conquest_general.

tv_train_grand_general = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_CONQUEST_GENERAL_CHAR_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			var:tv_conquest_general_char ?= {
				is_alive = yes
				is_female = no
				is_artist = no
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
					NOT = { has_variable = tv_gg_training_active }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_training_start_effect = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -100
	}
}

# ── Governor management actions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Governor appointment/removal is only available while an alive Grand General is in office.
# The Governor's House UI passes scope:target_1 (region) from each region row.
# Appoint/Change then select scope:target (character).

# Appoints a governor to the region pre-set as scope:target_1 by the UI.
tv_appoint_governor = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_CONQUEST_GENERAL_CHAR_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			var:tv_conquest_general_char ?= {
				is_alive = yes
				is_female = no
				is_artist = no
			}
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target_1 }
			scope:target_1 = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_GOVHOUSE_REGION_OWNED_TT
					any_location_in_region = {
						owner ?= scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_GOVHOUSE_REGION_HAS_NO_GOVERNOR_TT
				NOT = {
					scope:actor = {
						any_in_list = { variable = tv_governor_list
							OR = {
								var:tv_governed_region ?= scope:target_1
								var:tv_governed_area ?= {
									region = scope:target_1
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		trigger_else = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_GOVHOUSE_REGION_SELECTED_TT
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_appoint_governor_select_char"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_appoint_governor_no_chars"
		column = { data = character_info }
		visible = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_adult = yes
			is_female = no
			is_artist = no
			is_ruler = no
			is_heir = no
			is_consort = no
			is_loyal = yes
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_is_governor }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_effect = {
				tv_governor_appoint_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 0
	}
}

# Automatically appoints the highest-total-ability eligible characters into empty
# regional governor seats until there are no empty regions or no candidates.
tv_auto_assign_governors = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_CONQUEST_GENERAL_CHAR_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			var:tv_conquest_general_char ?= {
				is_alive = yes
				is_female = no
				is_artist = no
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_GOVHOUSE_HAS_EMPTY_GOVERNOR_REGION_TT
			scope:actor = {
				any_in_list = { variable = tv_govhouse_region_list
					save_temporary_scope_as = tv_govhouse_auto_candidate_region
					any_location_in_region = {
						owner ?= scope:actor
					}
					NOT = {
						scope:actor = {
							any_in_list = { variable = tv_governor_list
								OR = {
									var:tv_governed_region ?= scope:tv_govhouse_auto_candidate_region
									var:tv_governed_area ?= {
										region = scope:tv_govhouse_auto_candidate_region
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_GOVHOUSE_HAS_ELIGIBLE_GOVERNOR_CHARACTER_TT
			scope:actor = {
				any_character = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_adult = yes
					is_female = no
					is_artist = no
					is_ruler = no
					is_heir = no
					is_consort = no
					is_loyal = yes
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
						NOT = { has_variable = tv_is_governor }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_effect = {
				tv_governor_auto_assign_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 0
	}
}

# Dismisses the governor assigned to the region pre-set as scope:target_1 by the UI.

	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT

		}
	}

		custom_tooltip = {

			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_CONQUEST_GENERAL_CHAR_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			var:tv_conquest_general_char ?= {
				is_alive = yes
				is_female = no
				is_artist = no
			}
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target_1 }
			scope:target_1 = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_GOVHOUSE_REGION_OWNED_TT
					any_location_in_region = {
						owner ?= scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_GOVHOUSE_REGION_HAS_GOVERNOR_TT
				scope:actor = {
					any_in_list = { variable = tv_governor_list
						OR = {
							var:tv_governed_region ?= scope:target_1
							var:tv_governed_area ?= {
								region = scope:target_1
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		trigger_else = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_GOVHOUSE_REGION_SELECTED_TT
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			hidden_effect = {
				tv_governor_remove_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 0
	}
}

# Replaces the governor assigned to the region pre-set as scope:target_1 by the UI.

	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT

		trigger_else = {

	select_trigger = {

# ── War Tent actions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

tv_plan_offensive_strategy = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_CONQUEST_GENERAL_CHAR_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			var:tv_conquest_general_char ?= {
				is_alive = yes
				is_female = no
				is_artist = no
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_GOVHOUSE_NO_ACTIVE_WAR_PLAN_TT
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_plan_type }
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				every_neighbor_country = {
					limit = {
						country_type = location
						is_rebel_country = no
						capital = { is_discovered_by = scope:actor }
					}
					add_to_list = source
				}
			}
		}
		target_flag = target
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_select_offensive_plan_target"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_no_offensive_plan_target_available"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		column = { data = army_size }
		visible = {
			country_type = location
			this != scope:actor
			is_neighbor_of = scope:actor
			is_rebel_country = no
			capital = { is_discovered_by = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_govhouse_start_offensive_plan_effect = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_abort_war_plan = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_CONQUEST_GENERAL_CHAR_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			var:tv_conquest_general_char ?= {
				is_alive = yes
				is_female = no
				is_artist = no
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_GOVHOUSE_HAS_ACTIVE_WAR_PLAN_TT
				has_variable = tv_govhouse_plan_type
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_govhouse_clear_war_plan_effect = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_change_war_plan_target = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_CONQUEST_GENERAL_CHAR_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			var:tv_conquest_general_char ?= {
				is_alive = yes
				is_female = no
				is_artist = no
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_GOVHOUSE_HAS_OFFENSIVE_PLAN_TT
				has_variable = tv_govhouse_plan_type
				var:tv_govhouse_plan_type ?= 1
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				every_neighbor_country = {
					limit = {
						country_type = location
						is_rebel_country = no
						capital = { is_discovered_by = scope:actor }
					}
					add_to_list = source
				}
			}
		}
		target_flag = target
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_select_offensive_plan_target"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_no_offensive_plan_target_available"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		column = { data = army_size }
		visible = {
			country_type = location
			this != scope:actor
			is_neighbor_of = scope:actor
			is_rebel_country = no
			capital = { is_discovered_by = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_govhouse_start_offensive_plan_effect = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}
